components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

A witch-type performer brings the one skill the one on the circle has chosen to mastery, on a full-moon night. This one masters Extra skills.
Choose the skill on the Skills page of the hub. A skill that evolves when mastered evolves as it does in play, if its own conditions are met at that moment.
By default costs 300,000 base Max EP, spent once it is mastered, and 5 netherite ingots and 20 echo shards. One rite per player every 7 days.
